spans.s:
झट् झट्, cl. 1. P. झटति, &c., to become
matted together or entangled (as hair), to
become confused or intermixed.
झटा, f. the plant Flacourtia Cataphracta.

झाट, अस्, m. an arbour, bower, place overgrown
with creepers; a wood, a thicket; cleaning sores or
wounds; (आ or ई), f. jasmine, Jasminum Auriculatum.
झाट झाट. See under rt. झट्.
झटि, इस्, m. a small tree, a shrub, a bush.
झाटल, अस्, m. the tree Bignonia Suaveolens.
झाटिका or झाटीका, f. = झाटा above.

झटिति झटिति, ind. (fr. झट्, an onomato-
poetic word with इति; cf. पटिति), quickly, speedily,
instantly; at once; on the spot.

झाटामला झाटामला, f. = झाटा, Jasminum
Auriculatum; (according to others two separate words,
झाटा and अमला.)

झाटास्त्रक झाटास्त्रक, अस्, m. the water
melon.
